scripts.wasm: cargo build -p wasm --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir public/wasm --out-name wasm ${CARGO_TARGET_DIR:-../../target}/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/wasm.wasm
scripts.grammar: mkdir -p public/tree-sitter && tree-sitter build --wasm ../../packages/tree-sitter-into --output public/tree-sitter/into.wasm && cp ../../packages/tree-sitter-into/queries/highlights.scm node_modules/web-tree-sitter/web-tree-sitter.wasm public/tree-sitter/
